{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders
df_loyal_completed = df[(df['customer_segment'].str.lower() == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df_loyal_completed['revenue'] == 999999.99
qa_count = qa_mask.sum()

# Remove QA orders if any
if qa_count > 0:
    df_loyal_completed = df_loyal_completed[~qa_mask]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = df_loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Print results
print(f'Number of LOYAL completed orders: {len(df_loyal_completed)}')
print(f'QA orders removed: {qa_count}')
print(f'Mean revenue: {mean_revenue:.2f}')"}
